[spoiler=[b]Operation Beacon Wave[/b] - revised battle post]
The 10 minute timer elapsed with no sign of movement from the enemy. The admiral gave the order to fire, just as a boom was heard outside. The Kaiserreich had fired.

The Hydronian radars were filled with images of aircraft. It was clear they were not all present, so they must be decoys, a sneaky tactic from the reichswehr. But they werent just decoys, the Hydronian systems were jammed, making the Hydronians unable to counter the missiles incoming.

The bulk of the fleet was forced to move outwards, but many ships were hit and damaged in the first wave. Since the targeting systems were temporarily disabled, the aircraft carriers launched their arsenal of jets into the air. Xhawk-5 jets soared into the air to take on the reichswehr. In addition to this, swarms of drones were launched into the air. Combined, the hope was that they would distract and draw the enemy aircraft away from a potential landing site.

As a dogfight broke out in the sky, the Hydronians took it as an opportunity to recover their systems briefly. Cruise missiles were launched at the Nestorstaat coastal defences. In addition to this, with the enemys aircraft engaged in a dogfight, it provided an opportunity for Xowl-6 bombers to be deployed, carrying out precision strikes against the coastal defences, severely damaging a section of them, before returning and landing back on the aircraft carriers. This provided an opportunity for the 4 amphibious landing vessels to begin the move forward towards the landing site.

Back in the water, the remaining ships were taking a battering from the combined forces of Jomsland and the Kaiserreich. Continuous missile hits sunk half of the fleet, including an aircraft carrier, with the other severely damaged.

Midway through the battle however, help arrived from the south. The 15th fleet had been deployed from Bob fortress and provided backup ships as well as aircraft. Under cover from Xhawk-5 jets launching missiles, some of the fleet was able to escape, with 1 aircraft carrier sunk and 1 barely making it out. 2 of the cover jets were shot down and the others retreated back for Arenett help to arrive.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]The war has reached us[/b] - response to mainland attack]
The Technocratic navy now sat 300km off the coast of Hydronia. They thought they had hidden, they thought they had the advantage, but really it was all part of the Hydronian plan. Hydronia had seen their ships on radar, but if Hydronia fired upon their ships, they would appear as the aggressor, so they waited. When the Reichswehr attacked, they were ready.

As soon as movement from the ships was spotted, Hydronian missile systems stationed on the island of Windnia sprung to life. Surface-to-air missiles were quickly fired into the air against the Kaiserreichs planes. 

Jamming signals were a common tactic used by the Kaiserreich, and an effective one, but mounting them on aircraft was a mistake. Hydronia is able to fire missiles at the aircraft to disable them and the EW pods.

The enemy attempted to shoot missiles back, but Hydronias interception systems took down the majority of the missiles. As missiles continued to be fired back and forth, Hydronia had already begun recalling ships stationed across the North Sea. They also deployed ships from their ports across the north. The aim was to surround the TK ships. 

Across the country, jets were scrambled from airbases. The blue, red, purple and yellow squadrons took to the sky to defend Hydronia. The reichswehr attempted to carry out a bombing campaign, but the 4 squadrons intercepted the aircraft.

The ships quickly closed in around the Technocratic navy and sent the following message.
[b][i]Stand down NOW. You are surrounded and your aircraft have been intercepted. Call of the attack and we wont hurt you, dont and well be forced to down your pilots and sink your ships. The choice is yours[/i][/b]
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Presidents speech[/b] - formal declaration of war]
The face of President Kaplan Zorlu fills the screens of every TV across the nation as he  prepares to make his address to the nation regarding the war against EDU.

[i]To all Hydronians across the nation and anyone else who may be watching this, tonight I must announce that our country has once again been plunged into war.

Yesterday, our fleet was attacked by the technokratisches Kaiserreich off the coast of the Nestorstaat island. For the past month, this island has been under the oppressive and illegitimate control of the Kaiserreich. We are committed to putting the control of Nestorstaat back in the right hands, Sikirsks hands.

Earlier today, technocratic ships arrived at the Hydronian coast and tried to break us, but failed. After these malevolent actions against our people and our allies, our government has made the decision to formally declare war against the Technokratisches Kaiserreich. With this also comes a THEP joint operation, meaning that all THEP security council members are now empowered to begin attacks against the EDU.

We WILL NOT stand for the blatant bullying taking place by the EDU! May the future hold glory and peace for Erene![/i]
[/spoiler]
